description_en: Publishes specified routes or all visible routes under the same HTTP API in a batch
description_zh: 批量发布同一个 HTTP API 下的指定路由或全部可见路由
kebab_example: aliyun apig batch-deploy-http-api-routes --http-api-id api-example001 --route-ids '["hr-example001","hr-example002"]' --deploy-all false --async false --api-version 2024-03-27 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchDeployHttpApiRoutes

parameters.help_en: The ID of the HTTP API for the routing where you want to publish route entry in a batch
parameters.help_zh: 要批量发布路由的 HTTP API ID
parameters.name: http_api_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to publish routes asynchronously. Default value: true. An asynchronous publish returns the acceptance result of each route. If you set this parameter to false, the system waits for the batch processing to complete and returns the final result and statistics for each route
parameters.help_zh: 是否异步发布。默认为 true，返回各路由的受理结果。设为 false 时，等待本批处理完成后返回各路由的最终结果和统计
parameters.name: async

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to publish all routes visible to the current user under the API. Default value: false. If you set this parameter to true, all visible routes are targeted and routeIds is ignored
parameters.help_zh: 是否发布该 API 下当前用户可见的全部路由。默认为 false。设为 true 时，以全部可见路由为目标，忽略 routeIds
parameters.name: deploy_all

parameters.help_en: The list of route IDs to publish. If deployAll is omitted or set to false, you must provide at least one route ID. If any route does not exist or belongs to another API, the entire batch request is rejected
parameters.help_zh: 待发布的路由 ID 列表。省略 deployAll 或将其设为 false 时，至少提供一个路由 ID。任一路由不存在或属于其他 API 时，整批请求会被拒绝
parameters.name: route_ids

code.description_en: The response code of the API call. For the acceptance or publish result of each route, see data.results
code.description_zh: 本次 API 调用的响应码。各路由的受理或发布结果见 data.results

data.description_en: The route-level results of the batch publish. A synchronous publish also returns the number of successful and failed routes. An asynchronous publish returns only the route-level acceptance results
data.description_zh: 批量发布的逐路由结果。同步发布还返回成功和失败数量，异步发布仅返回逐路由受理结果

failedCount.description_en: The number of routes that fail to be published in the batch. This parameter is returned only for a synchronous publish and can be 0
failedCount.description_zh: 本批发布失败的路由数。仅在同步发布时返回，可为 0

additionalProperties.description_en: The acceptance result or final publish result of a single route
additionalProperties.description_zh: 单条路由的受理结果或最终发布结果

errorMessage.description_en: The cause of the rejection or publish failure of the route. This parameter is returned when status is Rejected or Failed
errorMessage.description_zh: 该路由被拒绝或发布失败的原因。status 为 Rejected 或 Failed 时可返回
errorMessage.example: ErrorType: Conflict, ErrorCode: DeployRouteForbidden, Message: the route  example-route is not allowed to deploy when it's status is Deploying., Params: [example-route Deploying]

routeId.description_en: The route ID that corresponds to the result. The value is the same as the key in results
routeId.description_zh: 该条结果对应的路由 ID，与 results 中的键相同

status.description_en: For an asynchronous publish, Pending indicates that the request is accepted, and Rejected indicates that the request is rejected before submission. For a synchronous publish, Succeeded indicates that the route is successfully published, and Failed indicates that the route fails to be published
status.description_zh: 异步发布时，Pending 表示已受理，Rejected 表示提交前被拒绝。同步发布时，Succeeded 表示发布成功，Failed 表示发布失败

results.description_en: A map of results with route IDs as keys. If other routes in the same batch fail, the successfully published routes remain valid
results.description_zh: 以路由 ID 为键的结果映射。同一批次中其他路由失败时，已经发布成功的路由仍然有效

successCount.description_en: The number of routes that are successfully published in the batch. This parameter is returned only for a synchronous publish and can be 0
successCount.description_zh: 本批发布成功的路由数。仅在同步发布时返回，可为 0

message.description_en: The response message of the API call. If a route fails or is rejected, see the errorMessage of the corresponding route for the cause
message.description_zh: 本次 API 调用的响应消息。路由失败或被拒绝时，原因见对应路由的 errorMessage

requestId.description_en: The request ID of the API call. You can invoke this ID to locate the active request
requestId.description_zh: 本次 API 调用的请求 ID，可用于定位这次请求

v1_body_parameters.help_en: Specifies the routes to publish and the execution mode
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 指定待发布的路由和执行方式
v1_body_parameters.name: body

v1_parameters.help_en: Specifies the routes to publish and the execution mode
v1_parameters.help_zh: 指定待发布的路由和执行方式
v1_parameters.name: body

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the HTTP API for the routing where you want to publish route entry in a batch
v1_parameters.help_zh: 要批量发布路由的 HTTP API ID
v1_parameters.name: httpApiId
